summary: Per-frame spring/damper force and steering computation for one wheel. Builds an orthonormal frame from the suspension axis (with a near-vertical fast path and a 2D fallback when this+0xBC is exactly 1.0), computes contact-frame forces, updates spring stiffness and force magnitude (zeroing all force outputs when the force drops to zero), tracks contact-patch displacement, clamps forces to the friction/grip circle, and writes the resulting force components back along the wheel's local axes.

operations.description: Branch on suspension compression: if this+0x3C <= 0.985 (near-vertical), use the full 3D suspension-geometry frame; otherwise take the simplified branch.
In the near-vertical branch, further branch on |this+0x38| >= 0.7071: if true, build the frame by cross-product of suspension axis this+0x38/0x3C/0x40 with the wheel basis and normalize.
In the |this+0x38| >= 0.7071 sub-branch, compute the normalized frame vectors (v41/v43/v45 and v35/v37/v39) from the suspension axis using cross products and a 1/sqrt normalization.
In the |this+0x38| < 0.7071 sub-branch, build the frame from the negated suspension axis and normalize it.
Project the wheel velocity (this+0x18/0x1C/0x20) onto the frame axes to obtain the lateral force v30 and longitudinal force v29.
In the simplified branch (this+0x3C > 0.985), if the packed flag this+0xBC equals 1.0, take the direct fallback: v30 = this+0x18, v29 = this+0x20.
In the simplified branch when this+0xBC != 1.0, apply the 2D rotation to the wheel velocity using this+0xBC/0xC0.
Compute longitudinal input v33 = v29 - this+0x90 * this+0x30 and damper state v34 = this+0xB8 * this+0x44 + this+0x58, then store v34 back into this+0x58.
Clamp damper velocity v9 to this+0xAC and scale by this+0xA8 to form the compression term.
Set spring stiffness this+0x48 to 5.0.
Compute spring force magnitude this+0x4C = (compression + 1.0) * this+0x9C * this+0x44.
If this+0x4C <= 0.0, zero out this+0x50, this+0x54, this+0xD8, this+0xDC, this+0xE0 and return immediately.
Set the force-active flag this+0x50 to 1.0.
If this+0x30 != 0.0, skip contact-patch tracking and jump to the grip-clamp block.
Compute contact displacement v47 = this+0xC4 - this+0x0 and v48 = this+0xC8 - this+0x8.
If the squared contact displacement >= 0.005625, skip the slip/skid computation block.
Project the contact-patch relative velocity onto the a2 basis vectors (a2[0..8], the second parameter) to obtain slip components v51/v54/v57.
Rotate the slip components into the suspension frame: if this+0x3C <= 0.985 use the 3D frame; else if this+0xBC == 1.0 take the direct component fallback; else apply the 2D rotation.

If the force magnitude squared exceeds the grip limit (this+0x4C squared), enter the friction-clamp block: update contact position this+0xC4/0xC8, scale forces by -(this+0x4C / speed * this+0x94), and renormalize when the result exceeds the grip circle.
Combine accumulated slip: v23 = this+0x54 - v15 * this+0x90; add or subtract damper state this+0x58 depending on the preceding comparison flags (v21|v22).
Compute the spring damping correction v25 = this+0x70 * this+0x6C * this+0x90 * v24 and the doubled term v26 = 2 * v25; form v27 = v33 - v26.
If v33 * v27 < 0, clamp the longitudinal force v15 to the damper-limited range using v31 = fabs(v27 / (v26 * this+0x90) * v24).
Update the slip accumulator this+0x54 = this+0x54 - v15 * this+0x90.

Write the final force components: if this+0x3C <= 0.985 store v35/v37/v39-rotated components into this+0xD8/0xDC/0xE0; else if this+0xBC == 1.0 store this+0xDC=0, this+0xE0=v15, this+0xD8=v58; else store the 2D-mixed components.

clean_pseudocode: // build orthonormal frame from suspension axis, then project velocity
lateral = dot(frame_x, wheel.velocity); longitudinal = dot(frame_z, wheel.velocity);
else { lateral = rot2D.a * wheel.velX - wheel.velZ * rot2D.b; longitudinal = rot2D.a * wheel.velZ + rot2D.b * wheel.velX; }
float damper = wheel.axisB * wheel.compVel + wheel.damperState; wheel.damperState = damper;
if (wheel.force <= 0.0) { wheel.active = 0; wheel.slip = 0; wheel.fx = wheel.fy = wheel.fz = 0; return; }
// contact-patch tracking + slip projection + force clamp against grip
